Together with your Group, create your Marionette, a soldier-rank NPC of construct type, under your control. It counts as an ally and has its own turn during conflicts. If you surrender, fall unconscious, build a new Marionette, or your Marionette is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it is immediately destroyed. You may also willingly dismiss your Marionette before or after an action.

You may perform the Inventory action and spend 2 to 6 Inventory Points to build your Marionette and make it join the current scene — if you use this Skill during a conflict, the Marionette joins the scene at the end of the current round. The Marionette has the following features:

  • Level 10 (gains the bonuses to Checks and Damage as per Step 8 of the Core Rulebook; it doesn’t gain EXP nor Level Up).
  • Maximum Hit Points equal to 【(the Marionette’s base Might die size × Inventory Points spent to build the Marionette) + half your level】.
  • No Mind Points — any MP cost incurred by the Marionette is taken from your MP.
  • Mindless (Special Rule): the Marionette is immune to the Shaken and confused status effects (doesn’t cost NPC Skill Points).
  • Construct-type NPC bonuses: Resistance to Earth damage; immunity to Poison damage and the Poisoned status; +2 Skill Points for customization.
  • One vulnerability of your choice.

props.classMechanic_text:
TAILOR — PLAY OVERVIEW & GUIDE

“Pin the seam, stitch the bond, fix the battlefield.”

What the Tailor Is (and Isn’t)

The Tailor is a support–skirmisher who anchors the party through a chosen Model—an ally you designate and then protect, buff, and retaliate through. You weave MP, Inventory Points, and Bonds into smart plays that reduce damage, punish attackers, and create powerful gear.

  • Core loop: Pick a Model → mitigate damage with Life Threads → punish enemies who hurt you or your Model → spend Inventory for utility and gear upgrades.
  • Your edge: You turn style (Rare Items, appearance) + teamwork (Bonds) into real numbers in checks and damage.

The Model System — Your Anchor Ally

Taking Measurements! (SL +4)

Use the Equipment action and spend 20 MP to designate a visible ally as your Model (lasts until they surrender/leave the scene/end the scene/you pick a new Model). The last enemy that damaged you or your Model takes [SL + Your Bond Strength toward the other] extra damage from your and your Model’s Attacks/Spells.

Our Bond Is Unbreakable! (SL +2)

Your bond strength toward your Model increases by +[SL]. When your Model uses Inventory, you may pay up to [SL+1] of the Inventory Points for them.

Damage Control — Keep the Outfit (Party) Together

Shared Attribution! (SL +5)

When a damaging attack/spell/effect hits you or your Model, either of you may spend 1 Inventory Point to sew a Life Thread: reduce the incoming damage by [SL] (before Affinities), then split the remaining damage evenly. This damage still counts for “on damage” triggers.

Looking Fabulous!

You and your Model gain a bonus equal to your # of equipped Rare Items in Objective actions and Opposed Checks tied to demeanor, appearance, or equipment.

Tailor-Made!

During a rest, destroy an item with a quality to add that quality to a same-type item that lacks one. Rare items crafted this way sell for 80 × your Tailor level extra zenit.

Heroic Skills — Couture for Boss Fights

Dance of the Marionette!

Spend 2–6 Inventory Points with the Inventory action to build a Marionette (soldier-rank construct ally; joins at the end of the round if made mid-conflict). Level 10 statline, HP = (base Might die × IP spent) + half your level. No MP (uses yours), mindless (immune to shaken/confused), construct bonuses, and one chosen vulnerability. If it hits 0 HP (or you surrender/leave), it’s destroyed. You can dismiss it anytime.

Down to Size!

Action; spend up to 40 MP. For every 20 MP spent, reduce a visible creature’s chosen Attribute die (DEX/INS/MGT/WLP) by one step (min d6). Stacks with other status effects and ends when the target Recovers (Villains can take the action).

Extra Spindle!

Before/after performing an action, spend MP in 10-MP steps. For each 10 MP, choose one of your current Spell effects—your Model also gains that effect. The copied effect lasts as long as yours. (GM sets any hard cap; many tables mirror 40 MP.)

How to Play the Tailor (Simple Gameplan)

  1. Designate a Model early with Taking Measurements! If you expect spread damage, switch Models mid-scene as needed (costs 20 MP).
  2. Soften spikes with Shared Attribution! Pay 1 Inventory Point to Life Thread the big hits, shave off [SL], then split the rest.
  3. Punish focus fire: after you/your Model are harmed, route counter-damage via the Taking Measurements! rider. Your bond bonus and SL push that number.
  4. Feed your Model: with Our Bond Is Unbreakable!, pay Inventory for them (potions, tools, projects) and stack your bond value.
  5. Leverage style: wear/craft Rare items to juice Looking Fabulous! checks (social pressure, feints, intimidation by drip).
  6. Between scenes, use Tailor-Made! to move qualities and monetize extras.
  7. Boss plan: pick one—Down to Size! to neuter a key Attribute, Extra Spindle! to copy clutch buffs to your Model, or Marionette to add an extra body/positioning tool.

Attributes & Build Advice (Quick)

  • Willpower fuels your MP budget for Measuring/Spindle/Down-size plays.
  • Insight / Dexterity help your accuracy/defense line for attacks and objective checks.
  • Inventory Points matter: Shared Attribution (1 IP), Marionette (2–6 IP), and covering your Model’s Inventory costs.
  • Gear plan: chase Rare qualities you can transplant; keep a “donor” piece handy for Tailor-Made!

Pocket Card (Hand to Players)

  1. Pick Model (20 MP) — start the damage-rider engine.
  2. When hit: spend 1 IP → Life Thread → reduce by [SL], then split evenly.
  3. Cover your Model’s Inventory up to [SL+1] and enjoy a bigger bond.
  4. Style checks get bonus = # of Rare items (you + Model).
  5. Rest: move qualities with Tailor-Made!; craft/sell.
  6. Heroic picks (choose per fight): add a Marionette, Down to Size! an Attribute, or Extra Spindle! to copy your buffs to your Model.
